summary: Galiano Gold Inc. filed a Form 6-K on May 11, 2026, reporting positive drill assay results from the Abore drilling program at the Asanko Gold Mine in Ghana, West Africa. The filing describes step-out and infill drilling that extends mineralization at depth and along strike, with highlights including 32m at 4.7 g/t Au and 53m at 3.9 g/t Au. There are no deal terms, board recommendations, advisors, or regulatory clocks. This is a routine operational update from a foreign private issuer reporting exploration results, not a special situation.
